failures_preserved.reason: Changing W outside the public PFET model bin prevented simulator model selection. Internal geometry is fixed, but header inputs can still affect model selection. No general arbitrary-W/L invariance is claimed. Subsequent controls stay within all explicit public model bins: W times 0.9 and L times 0.999.
The assertion exposed inactive generic MOS kp/vto/lambda search targets on PDK devices. These and fixed dimensions are now excluded; direct saved-study edits of inactive parameters are rejected.

GF180 has mismatched .ends labels. The inventory now retains those diagnostics while preserving balanced scopes. Literal double-prefix expansion of qualified SKY130 diode alternatives remains explicitly recorded instead of becoming a guessed runtime binding.

The snapshot copy excluded .log files, omitting a required authenticated oracle fixture. The repository fixture was intact. The complete fixtures were restored from the frozen source archive and the full suite rerun; original failed logs are preserved.

Reconstructing Windows complex magnitudes on Linux failed exact float equality. The observed vector differs by one ULP on seven samples. The same-host Windows audit independently re-read all 162 raw files and passed exact sample equality and every comparison, without changing tolerances or simulator data.

failures_preserved.reason: The full run records 37 errors from restricted loopback sockets and directory junctions, plus 36 explicit skips. The first retry resolves 23 tests but lacks a sibling test import for 14. With the original discovery import path restored and local test access available, all 37 pass. Original full and first-retry failures remain unchanged.

historical_source_preservation: The exact analog_optimizer.py, project_ui.py and studies.py bytes used by the earlier GF180 physical gate are retained under a new linked historical snapshot. This preserves that earlier claim only; no current-source physical acceptance is inferred.
